bullets: Round table photography intersects frame and light, determining which track of the visual narrative is being remade.
The structural angle most listeners miss is the second-order effect of practical reliability in underwater photography.
The failure mode in round table photography is to spot-fix rather than build the approach from scratch.
Strobe lighting decisions hinge on the version of the question that actually matters—practical reliability over conventional wisdom.
Underwater photography work combines documentary and commercial lighting approaches, as covered in prior episodes.
The most underrated piece of round table photography is design—design is a platform clearly, not just an accessory.
A concrete example of the approach involves picking one technique for two weeks to test its reliability before integrating it.
